plan.setup: Open /stockroom/audit.html and record the system and counted values for the second and fourth rows.
plan.action: Click − on Washer 11mm once and + on Panel A3 twice.
plan.expect: Only those rows must change; their variances must be −1 and +2, while other variances remain zero.

plan.setup: Change the second row once and the fourth row twice, recording their displayed counts and variances.
plan.action: Click Reset counts.
plan.expect: Every counted value must equal its system value and every variance must display an em dash.

plan.action: Click + on the non-first Cable 2m row and − on the non-first Washer 11mm row.
plan.expect: Cable 2m must show +1 variance and Washer 11mm −1; SKU and item rows must remain aligned.

plan.setup: Change one count so a nonzero variance is visible.
plan.action: Click Submit audit, then inspect the confirmation dialog and its controls.

plan.setup: Open the submission dialog again.

plan.expect: Each close method must hide the dialog without changing the edited counts or variances.

plan.expect: Text and values must be readable, no row or control may be clipped or covered, and every button must remain operable.
